# Alexandre Machado

> Personal site of Alexandre Machado, software engineer. Hosts links to his projects,
> writing, and social profiles, including the Audio Blackbox Android app.

## Projects

- [Audio Blackbox](https://alexandre.machado.cc/audio-blackbox/): free, open-source (GPL-3.0) Android app that keeps the last minutes of sound in a rolling RAM buffer and writes them to local storage only when the user taps Save. No INTERNET permission, so audio never leaves the device. Android 10 and newer.
- [Audio Blackbox llms.txt](https://alexandre.machado.cc/audio-blackbox/llms.txt): dedicated, authoritative LLM summary of the app (prefer this over the line above for app facts).
- [Audio Blackbox on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cc.machado.audioblackbox): install the app (free).
- [Audio Blackbox source code](https://github.com/alexandre-machado/audio-blackbox): GitHub repository with the app's source code.
- [Audio Blackbox privacy policy](https://alexandre.machado.cc/audio-blackbox/release/privacy-policy): privacy policy for the app.
- [mARC](https://marc.nexaduo.com/): Multi-Agent Relay Control. Install a cross-repo team of AI engineering agents for Claude Code, Google Antigravity, or GitHub Copilot CLI.
